short_description: Define target accounts, prevent duplicate outreach, qualify buying roles, and capture SQL evidence cleanly.

questions.question: How are target accounts selected and what makes an account suitable?
questions.placeholder: e.g. ICP criteria (headcount, sector, tech stack) built by sales lead...

questions.question: Where is account research stored and how do you prevent duplicate outreach?
options: Central CRM deduplication checked before adding sequences
Shared spreadsheets — sometimes two reps message same company
Kept in individual SDR lists
Not sure

questions.question: How are buying roles and decision-makers identified?
questions.placeholder: e.g. LinkedIn Sales Navigator mapping VP/Director + procurement contact...

questions.question: Who approves outreach messaging and cadence?
options: Sales lead / founder approves playbook templates
Each rep writes and adjusts their own outreach
Not sure

questions.question: How are responses, objections and next steps recorded?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Logged in CRM activity notes with scheduled follow-up task...

questions.question: What evidence is required before an account becomes sales-qualified?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Confirmed need, budget ballpark, decision stakeholder, target timeline...

questions.question: How are dormant, disqualified or reactivated accounts handled?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Marked with reason code in CRM and queued for 90-day revisit...

process_name: Discovery to proposal and commercial approval
short_description: Structure discovery insights, map procurement stakeholders, review delivery risk & margin, and track proposal approvals.

questions.question: What information is collected before and during discovery?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Current workflows, KPIs, tech environment, blockers, buying timeline...

questions.question: How do you document the client's problem, desired outcome and buying criteria?
options: Standardised discovery summary in CRM
Personal call notes or slide deck drafted fresh
Mostly remembered by salesperson
Not sure

questions.question: Who confirms decision-makers, procurement steps and approval path?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Account executive maps economic buyer, legal review, and security questionnaire...

questions.question: How is scope, resourcing, timeline and delivery risk estimated?
options: Delivery lead co-scopes effort & capacity before proposal goes out
Sales estimates using rough past deals without checking delivery calendar
Not sure

questions.question: Who reviews pricing, margin, commitments and non-standard terms?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Managing director / finance approves discounts or custom SLAs...

questions.question: How is proposal version, approval and client feedback tracked?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Proposal tool tracks opens/versions, or v1/v2 PDFs emailed...

questions.question: What must happen before a verbal agreement becomes a signed engagement?
questions.placeholder: e.g. MSA + SOW executed, PO number received, and first invoice raised...

short_description: Transfer commercial commitments cleanly to delivery teams, verify capacity & scope boundaries, and launch kickoff.

questions.question: What exact event triggers the handoff from sales to delivery?
options: Signed contract + deposit invoice cleared
Deal moved to Closed-Won in CRM
Sales rep pings delivery channel when client verbally agrees
Not sure

questions.question: What client goals, promised outcomes, scope boundaries and risks must be transferred?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Signed SOW, discovery recordings, stakeholder politics, custom deadlines...

questions.question: Who checks handoff completeness and accepts delivery ownership?
options: Delivery lead formally accepts handoff checklist before kickoff
Whoever is assigned reads whatever docs are in CRM
No formal acceptance — work begins after quick chat
Not sure

questions.question: How are stakeholders, approvers, communication rules and escalation paths confirmed?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Covered in kickoff deck and documented in project charter...

questions.question: What inputs, access or data are needed before delivery starts?
questions.placeholder: e.g. System permissions, data exports, SME interview calendar...

questions.question: How are milestones and success measures agreed at kickoff?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Mutual 30/60/90-day milestone plan signed off in kickoff recap...

questions.question: What happens when sales commitments conflict with delivery capacity or the signed scope?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Escalated to leadership/account director to renegotiate timeline or add contractor...

short_description: Start renewal preparation early, assess account outcomes & risk, justify scope expansion, and govern commercial terms.

questions.question: How early before contract end does the renewal process begin?
options: 60–90 days prior with automated CRM reminder
30 days prior
In the final couple of weeks or when contract lapses
Not sure

questions.question: What delivery, relationship, usage or outcome information is reviewed?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Results vs KPIs, hours/margin health, stakeholder turnover, NPS...

questions.question: Who identifies renewal risk and who owns the account plan?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Account director flags risk in monthly review and owns renewal plan...

questions.question: How are client stakeholders and decision-makers engaged?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Quarterly Executive Business Review presenting ROI and next-phase roadmap...

questions.question: What evidence is required before recommending expansion or a scope change?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Proven baseline results + identified bottleneck or unmet client goal...

questions.question: Who approves commercial terms and contract changes?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Finance + managing partner approve fee adjustments or multi-year discounts...

questions.question: How are renewal decisions, risks and next actions recorded?
questions.placeholder: e.g. Logged in CRM renewal pipeline with signed addendum archived...
